environment.render: CPU kinematic reconstruction of selected actual GPU state; no extra physics

posture.scope: After first second, trunk upright and signed foot-site-center proxy; not mesh clearance

environment.evaluation_rule: Prospective functional development screen with one-second body-XY means; retain original instantaneous flags
environment.zero_input_rule: Identical policy inputs imply identical CPU inference; do not require cross-process contact trajectories to coincide
environment.scope: Isolated fixed-controller walking in common fullcontact plant with legal destinations; no continuous-entry or hardware claim
environment.reset_rule: Only mandatory ended unscored worlds; first-episode masks never reopen; terminal captured before reset

feedback.condition: active forward worlds after the matched prefix
features: sum of observed hip pitch velocities
feedback.per_world_sensor_memory: Reset with each world and restore with the shared branch snapshot.
feedback.target_projection: Project normal and alternate ONNX targets into the original joint envelope, then uniformly scale the correction vector to the joint cap.

backward_preservation: No negative matched net change versus the equal-weight arm in either seed.

direction_pilot.scope: Run two reference repeats and the inferred-direction controller from the same restored state. Validate actual first-step gains and the sustained 2.32-second post-fork behavior. This pilot does not score the full 20-second episode or consume final holdout.

direction_fresh.first_step_coverage: Report real support and changes without the per-side pilot quota. Full episode outcomes and the original paired comparison govern admission.
